setupBody: No owner exists yet. Enter the setup token from the server's environment to create the owner account. After this, sign-up closes.
setupTokenHelp: The SETUP_TOKEN value from the .env file.
name: Your name
passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. Used as a backup to your passkey.
recoveryBody: Each code works once if you lose your passkey and authenticator. They are shown only now.
passkeyBody: A passkey lets you sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. It is the main way to sign in.
passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use the password for now.
codeHelp: Needed when two-step verification is on.
login_failed: E-mail, password or code is wrong.
totp_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
registration_closed: This install already has an owner. Ask the owner for an invitation.
passkey_unknown: This passkey is not registered here.
reauthBody: This action is sensitive. Confirm with your passkey or password.

inviteInvalid: This invitation is not valid or has expired.
